description: Sam Fakerson, 36, a freelance UX designer renting in Austin, Texas. Credit union checking and savings, a Capital One Venture and a Chase Freedom Flex. One retainer client plus irregular project payments; sets aside a share of each large payment for tax and pays quarterly estimates. Carries a card balance through lean months and pays interest. Software subscriptions come and go. Ten days in Lisbon paid partly in euros.
